issues.title: Real SC2 lacked a typed structure census and bounded combat probe
issues.detail: Stage 21 had live typed action control but no read-only structure census or target-class combat boundary.
issues.resolution: The canonical kernel, mirrors, Host, simulator, and registry now expose typed census and attack handlers. The fresh Stage 22 window passed all census, invalid-target, valid-attack, frame, and initialization assertions.

issues.title: SC2 CreateGame rejected the staging directory and an unresolved packed path
issues.detail: A raw staging directory and an early relative packed-map call both returned CreateGame error 2.
issues.resolution: The map is now packed with the existing StormLib tool, the runner resolves the map before CreateGame, and the repo-relative final invocation passed. The portable path rule is recorded in the project-local vibe-operator-workflow skill.

issues.title: Full real-SC2 objective clearance remains unverified
issues.detail: The typed probe destroyed one target and observed 194 remaining enemy structures. This is a combat/census boundary, not a runtime all-objectives-success result.
issues.nextAction: Implement a temporary Stage 23 controller that repeatedly censuses valid enemy structures, issues typed attacks, advances frames, handles stale targets and reinforcements, and asserts zero remaining objective structures without changing native initialization.
